name: Switchroom heater auxiliary feeder
summary: Shows the assigned supply circuit for room or enclosure conditioning heaters.
description: Shows the assigned supply circuit for room or enclosure conditioning heaters. An auxiliary AC distribution diagram identifies the supplies serving room services and control-support equipment. Essential, backed-up and ordinary circuits can have different source paths and operating priorities.

In a switchroom, the lighting, service sockets, charger input and room cooling may be fed from different auxiliary branches. A source change must preserve the identities of loads that require continuity. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Heater supply branch” at the input and “Conditioning heater input” at the output. Heater availability does not establish humidity control.
